title: Rewinding the Captured Word
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $x$ be an input, and let $s$ be any configuration of $M$ on $x$. For a Boolean word $u$ and $n\in\mathbb{N}$ with $n\le |u|$, starting from the pairing configuration that preserves $s$, has control state $3$, input head at its initial position, capture tape containing $u$ with its head at offset $n-1$, and empty output, after exactly $n+1$ steps the machine is in the corresponding configuration with control state $4$, capture head at offset $0$, and all other fields unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
replaced:
For every $n \le |u|$: from the canonical pairing configuration in the
capture-rewind state with the capture head at offset $n - 1$ and empty output,
exactly $n + 1$ steps return the head to the origin and enter the replay state,
with all other fields unchanged.
